story:
For over 25 years Comfortable Climate has provided comfort, peace of mind and healthy environments for residential and commercial customers across Northeastern Pennsylvania. By installing, maintaining and servicing HVAC and plumbing systems we offer warmth, relief from the heat, clean fresh air and a reliable water supply.

We are locally owned and operated out of Dallas, PA, and owner Joe Szczechowicz still does the estimates himself. That is why so many of our reviews name him personally rather than naming a company — customers deal with the person who is going to be responsible for the work. Our goal is that every customer is satisfied enough to recommend us to their family and friends, and we are dedicated to giving our team the most progressive training and up-to-date tools needed to complete each project properly. In 2024 that training was recognized when Fujitsu awarded us Elite Contractor status on their ductless equipment.

Our diverse portfolio ranges from residential service work to commercial business developments, and we hold Pennsylvania registration PA #091633. Whether it is a no-heat call in January, a leaking water heater on a Tuesday morning, or a full ductless installation in a house that never had ductwork, the process is the same: an honest diagnosis first, a written estimate second, and the work done the way we would want it done in our own home.
